messages:
Raya (PM): Quick thread: RetailBank flagged they need a Console slice that ties "why costs spiked" to example traces and error types for exec review. Proposed MVP: (1) small Cost Explorer tile: top-5 routes by estimated spend, (2) Error Breakdown: top error codes + trend, (3) Lightweight trace hook that captures trace refs + one-line error cause (no full payload). Keep it minimal for privacy.

Diego (Eng): Agree on minimality. For cost estimate we can use tokens * model_rate + per-request fixed overhead. Will call it 'estimate' everywhere. For traces: emit {trace_id, route, error_code, timestamp, sample_flag} only. No PII.

Nina (SRE): Retention default 3d for sampled traces? Keeps storage small. Add circuit-breaker: if trace envelopes/sec > 1000 for org => auto-reduce sampling by 10x and send alert.

Omar (Data): Front-end will need route->model profile mapping. We can auto-infer model profile from recent calls and show confidence score. If confidence < 0.6 show "profile uncertain" tooltip. Estimated spend UI column shows value + range.

Tess (Eng-Platform): Plan: two mini-sprints. Sprint 1: route aggregation metrics, UI tiles, sampling API. Sprint 2: trace-envelope hook, rollout to one pilot org, alerting. Minimal proto: 6 fields, <512 bytes.

Raya (PM): Launch checks I want: - Dashboard renders top-5 spend routes and error trend - Per-route sampling toggle in Console - Pilot org onboarded and verified - No p95 latency regression in pilot (compare baseline) - UX tooltip explaining estimate formula

Diego (Eng): Add config snippet for runtime flags: 
```yaml
obs:
  cost_estimates: true
  trace_envelope:
    enabled: true
    default_sampling: 0.01
    retention_days: 3
    max_payload_bytes: 512
```
We'll gate the feature behind a feature-flag.

Nina (SRE): Also require an alert: `console.obs.trace_envelope_surge` (threshold: envelopes/sec > org_baseline * 5) which triggers auto-throttle. And a dashboard showing retained storage used per-org.

Omar (Data): UX copy: "Estimated spend is derived from token counts and model profiles. It's for planning and diagnostics, not billing."

Raya (PM): Owners: Tess -> UI tiles + sampling API, Diego -> trace envelope + feature flag, Omar -> model-profile inference + tooltip copy, Nina -> alerts + retention policy. I'll book a 20m pilot review with RetailBank next Wed.

OpsBot: Created alert templates `console.obs.trace_envelope_surge` and `console.obs.p95_latency_regression`.
